answer: The zenith schedule is applied in canyon and pulse exposes each instalment. An attacker hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 33% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3254 identities would post 3137 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
